This role is for someone who has a strong pulse on internet culture, loves bringing order to ambitious ideas, and can balance creative thinking with operational excellence. If you enjoy building campaigns that people don't just see, but genuinely engage with, you'll fit right in.

Role Overview
 
We just don't collaborate, we partner with brands!
You'll be right in the middle of making those partnerships stronger, smarter, and more impactful. We are on a mission to build the most rewarding payments app for the next generation and your role will bring huge impact on the experience of 10M+ users on Fam’s platform.
If you love creating win-win collaborations, thrive in fast-paced environments, and know how to turn ideas into revenue — this one’s for you.
 
Must-Haves
3+ years of experience in Partnerships, Business Development, Strategic Alliances, or Revenue-focused roles.
Experience working with consumer brands, fintech, e-commerce companies, advertising agencies, or platform/marketplace ecosystems.
Strong understanding of two-sided marketplace dynamics and value propositions.
Demonstrated commercial acumen with the ability to identify, negotiate, and close partnership opportunities that drive revenue.
Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience collaborating across internal teams and external partners.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including creating partnership decks, drafting negotiation emails, and preparing internal alignment documents.
Strong negotiation and relationship-building abilities. 
Data-driven mindset with the ability to track partnership performance and identify growth opportunities.
Builder mentality — thrives in ambiguity and moves fast
Ability to manage multiple partnerships and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Good to Haves
Experience working in high-growth startups or scaling businesses.
Experience with GTM planning, co-marketing initiatives, or strategic alliance programs.
Roles & Responsibilities
Own and nurture relationships with existing partners, ensuring regular engagement and a seamless partner experience.
Act as the primary point of contact for partner queries, follow-ups, and day-to-day communication.
Build strong rapport with partners and confidently drive conversations to identify opportunities for deeper collaboration.
Support commercial discussions, partnership renewals, and new partnership opportunities alongside internal stakeholders.
Create partnership presentations, proposals, meeting notes, and other communication materials as required.
Coordinate with internal teams such as Product, Marketing, Operations, and Finance to ensure smooth execution of partner initiatives.
Track partnership performance, maintain regular updates, and share key insights with the team.
Identify opportunities to strengthen existing partnerships through campaigns, activations, or cross-functional initiatives.
Maintain accurate partnership documentation and ensure timely follow-ups on ongoing discussions.
Represent the company professionally in partner meetings, networking events, and industry interactions.
Why Join Us
Build a category-defining brand for the next generation in India.
Work directly with founders and leadership in a high-visibility role with ownership from day one.
Own partnerships that directly drive business growth and revenue.
Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership culture where builders make an impact.
Work in an AI-native environment with access to the best AI tools to move faster and build smarter.

Role Overview

We’re looking for an IT Manager to own and scale our network, endpoint, and IT operations infrastructure. This role goes beyond maintenance - you will drive reliability, security, compliance, and operational excellence across the organization. You will be responsible for building robust, audit-ready systems, reducing manual toil through automation, and ensuring seamless IT experience at scale.

What You’ll Own

  1. Network & Infrastructure Reliability
    • Own end-to-end network infrastructure: firewalls, switches, routers, and wireless
    • Ensure high uptime via redundancy planning, VPN management, and ISP SLAs
    • Monitor performance, logs, and alerts; proactively resolve issues
    • Drive secure network architecture (segmentation, access control, Zero Trust principles
  2. Security & Compliance
    • Manage enterprise firewall configurations (policy, NAT, VPNs)
    • Own ISO 27001 readiness: controls, audits, SOPs, and access reviews
    • Lead IAM lifecycle: provisioning, de-provisioning, RBAC
    • Oversee endpoint security: EDR, DLP, monitoring tools
    • Respond to incidents, conduct log reviews, and strengthen security posture
  3. Endpoint & IT Operations
    • Manage Mac, Windows, and Linux environments at scale
    • Own MDM systems (enforcement, compliance, lifecycle—not just enrollment)
    • Drive patch management, backups, and disaster recovery readiness
    • Administer Google Workspace (users, groups, policies, security settings)
    • Manage IT asset lifecycle: procurement → provisioning → offboarding
  4. Operational Excellence 
    •  Own ITSM systems (SLA creation, not just execution)
    • Build and improve SOPs, runbooks, and documentation
    • Reduce manual work via scripting and automation
    • Ensure audit-ready documentation and system visibility 
  5. Team & Stakeholder Management
    • Lead and grow a team of IT professionals (5+ members)
    • Partner with vendors for procurement, renewals, and support
    • Collaborate cross-functionally on security, compliance, and IT needs

Must-Have Experience

  • 8–12 years in IT infrastructure & operations, with 3+ years in leadership
  • Experience managing IT for 500+ users • Strong hands-on expertise in:
    • Firewalls (policy management, NAT, VPN) 
    • Layer 3 networking (routing, VLANs, ACLs)
    • Network fundamentals (routing, NAT, VPNs, troubleshooting)
  • Experience with MDM / endpoint management systems
  • Strong understanding of network + security fundamentals
  • Experience with:
    • Patch management, backups, monitoring tools
    • Google Workspace administration
    • EDR, DLP, and security monitoring platforms
  • Proficiency in shell scripting / automation
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills

What Sets You Apart

  • Certifications: CCNA/CCNP/CCIE, CompTIA Network+/Security+, or equivalent
  • Experience with Zero Trust / SASE architectures
  • Exposure to cloud or hybrid environments (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Hands-on with tools like JumpCloud or similar IAM/MDM platforms
  • Experience in fintech/BFSI or regulated environments
  • Built IT systems for scale + compliance (not just support)

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • Network and endpoint systems are highly reliable and secure
  • IT operations are predictable, automated, and audit-ready
  • Security posture is proactive, not reactive
  • Employees have a seamless, low-friction IT experience
  • Clear SOPs and systems reduce dependency on individuals

Why This Role Matters

  • You will own the backbone of the company’s infrastructure
  • You’ll operate at the intersection of security, scale, and reliability
  • You’ll help build systems that are ready for next-stage growth and compliance

descriptionPlain:
About Fam
Fam (previously FamPay) is India's first payments app for everyone above 11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ youngest users in India to kickstart their financial journey early in their lives. Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder's Capital, and angels including Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao
Role Overview
Every great product starts with a great team. And every great team is built with intention.
As our People & Culture Head, you'll partner with leaders to build high-performing teams, shape an exceptional employee experience, and create the people practices that help Fam scale. From hiring exceptional talent to strengthening our culture and enabling our people to do their best work, you'll play a key role in building the company behind the product.
If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, solving people challenges, and creating a workplace where talented people thrive, we'd love to build the future of Fam with you.
Must-Haves
Hiring: Hands-on experience building high-functioning tech, product, design, and non-tech teams—personally sourced, interviewed, and closed candidates across these functions.
HRBP Experience: Partnered with leadership on org structure, retention strategies, and comp planning while embedding company culture into hiring and performance decisions.
Empathy + Business Acumen: Genuinely cares about teams well-being and acts as a trusted advisor, connects people decisions to business outcomes (retention impact, hiring ROI, etc.).
First-Principles Thinking & Problem Solving: Demonstrates a structured approach to solving problems by breaking them down into their core components, asking the right clarifying questions, considering the business context, and arriving at thoughtful, practical solutions.
Strategic Mindset: Understands how to position the company to attract top talent, thinks ahead about evolving talent needs, and makes decisions with a long-term perspective aligned to business goals.
Long-Term Growth Potential: Sees themselves leading the People function for the next 4-5 years, invested in building something meaningful long-term, and can evolve and grow with Fam's journey. 
Strong Network: Has built genuine relationships and credibility in the ecosystem—people know them, trust them, and they can leverage these connections to attract quality candidates and leaders to Fam.
Team Player: Experience working with a team of minimum 5 members
Good to Haves
Tools: Hands on worked with Keka, Lever, Google Sheets, Equitylist.
People Operations: Owned the full employee experience and built scalable HR systems and processes.
AI-Native Mindset: Demonstrates an understanding of what it takes to build an AI-native organization, proactively identifies opportunities where AI can create leverage across functions, and can drive adoption through thoughtful change management and cross-functional collaboration
Roles & Responsibilities
Top Talent Hunter: Build the best functioning teams, ensuring we have the right people in the right roles
Strategic Partner to the Business: Work closely with business leaders to anticipate organizational needs, identify talent risks, and build people strategies that enable the next stage of growth. Be the person leaders turn to before people problems arise, not after.
Drive Talent Decisions Beyond Hiring: Bring a strong talent lens to business discussions by leveraging deep experience in Tech, Product, and Design hiring. Influence org design, team structures, succession planning, and workforce strategy through an understanding of what great talent looks like.
Build for Scale: Partner with People Ops to ensure employee lifecycle processes, policies, and programs are designed for scale. While not directly working on operations, bring best-practice thinking and challenge the status quo to create exceptional employee experiences.
Shape People Infrastructure: Work closely with Legal to draft, review, and evolve people policies that balance compliance with a high-trust culture. Ensure policies are practical, scalable, and aligned with the company's growth trajectory.
Workforce Planning & Business Forecasting: Partner with Finance and business leaders on headcount planning, hiring forecasts, organisational investments, and future workforce requirements. Help leaders make informed decisions through people and business insights.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Coach leaders on performance, talent decisions, team effectiveness, and organizational challenges. Enable managers to build high-performing, engaged teams rather than relying on HR to solve people problems for them.
Why Join Us

 • 3–5 yrs in performance marketing 
  • Strong experience in B2C/ product based companies
  • Hands-on: Google Ads + Meta Ads
  • Strong MMP experience 
  • Solid understanding of attribution, funnel metrics, incrementality
  • Proven ability to scale installs with controlled CAC
  • Strong analytical + experimentation skills
  • High ownership; executes fast

• Gen Z audience understanding
 • Experience operating at scale — large budgets, high velocity experiments, consistent growth
 • Basic creative strategy understanding

  • Manage large budgets with focus on CAC and quality installs
  • Continuously optimize campaigns

  • Identify new scalable acquisition opportunities

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Performance Marketer to build and scale Fam’s paid acquisition engine.

This is a 1→10 role — you’ll own end-to-end growth across Google and Meta, drive high-quality user acquisition at scale, and turn performance marketing into a predictable, efficient growth lever.

This role sits at the intersection of growth, product, and analytics — requiring sharp execution, strong attribution thinking, and a deep understanding of user funnels.

Must-haves
 • 3–5 yrs in performance marketing 
  • Strong experience in B2C/ product based companies
  • Hands-on: Google Ads + Meta Ads
  • Strong MMP experience 
  • Solid understanding of attribution, funnel metrics, incrementality
  • Proven ability to scale installs with controlled CAC
  • Strong analytical + experimentation skills
  • High ownership; executes fast 
  • Has AI native mindset

Good to haves
• Gen Z audience understanding
 • Experience operating at scale — large budgets, high velocity experiments, consistent growth
 • Basic creative strategy understanding

Roles and Responsibilities

1. Paid Acquisition (Own)
  • Own and scale Google + Meta for user acquisition
  • Manage large budgets with focus on CAC and quality installs
  • Continuously optimize campaigns

2. Attribution & Measurement (Own)
  • Own MMP setup, tracking, and attribution accuracy
  • Track performance across channels and resolve overlaps
  • Build and monitor core metrics: CAC, CPI, activation rate, LTV

3. Funnel Optimization (Own)
  • Improve install → KYC → activation → transaction funnel
  • Identify drop-offs and work with product to fix them
  • Optimize for downstream metrics, not just installs

4. Experimentation (Own)
  • Run high-velocity A/B tests across audiences, creatives, and bidding
  • Test new channels and scale what works
  • Drive a strong experimentation culture with clear learnings

5. Creative Iteration (Drive)
  • Work with design/content to build high-performing ad creatives
  • Identify winning hooks for Gen Z (formats, messaging, trends)
  • Rapidly iterate based on performance data

6. Growth & Efficiency (Own)
  • Balance scale vs efficiency (CAC, LTV, payback)
  • Improve channel ROI and reduce dependency on any single platform
  • Identify new scalable acquisition opportunities

Why Join Us
  • Opportunity to build a category-defining brand for the next generation in India
  • Work directly with founders and leadership
  • Own a high-impact growth lever from day one
  • Fast-paced, high-ownership culture

lists.content:
• 5–8 years of software engineering experience with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Strong proficiency in Go or Python, with experience building production-grade backend systems, frameworks, or internal platforms.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems concepts including concurrency, consistency, fault tolerance, caching, rate limiting, locking, and service coordination.
  • Experience designing reusable libraries, services, or infrastructure abstractions consumed by multiple engineering teams.
  • Strong software design skills with emphasis on maintainability, extensibility, and clean API design.
  • Experience writing comprehensive unit, integration, and system-level test suites.
  • Ability to reason about edge cases, failure scenarios, race conditions, and system correctness.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures, containerized environments, and modern engineering tooling.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and system design capabilities.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills

Platform Services Development

  • Design and build reusable platform services and infrastructure primitives that can be adopted across multiple engineering teams.

    • System Design

    • Architect scalable, reliable, and extensible systems with well-defined interfaces, operational simplicity, and long-term maintainability.

      • Engineering Foundations

      • Develop shared libraries, SDKs, APIs, and platform abstractions that reduce duplication and improve engineering velocity across the organization.

        • Reliability & Correctness

        • Design systems with failure handling, fault tolerance, concurrency safety, and operational resilience built in from the start.

          • Validation & Testing

          • Build comprehensive test strategies to validate scalability, correctness, and reliability through stress testing, fault injection, simulation, and automated verification.

            • Technical Ownership

            • Own platform components end-to-end, from design and implementation to adoption, observability, and long-term evolution.

              • Cross-Team Collaboration

              • Partner closely with application and infrastructure teams to understand platform needs and drive adoption of shared services.

                • Continuous Improvement

                • Identify opportunities to simplify engineering workflows, improve developer productivity, and enhance platform capabilities through reusable solutions.

• Opportunity to build foundational platform capabilities that impact every engineering team.
  • Solve challenging distributed systems and infrastructure problems.
  • High ownership environment with the freedom to influence architecture and engineering standards.
  • Work alongside strong engineers on products used at scale.

About this Role:
We are looking for high-impact Technical Lead Manager to drive the development of scalable, high-performance systems for our fintech platform. You will play a crucial role in architecting, building, and optimizing distributed systems, data pipelines, and query performance. If you love solving complex engineering challenges and want to shape the future of financial technology, this role is for you.

lists.content:
• Lead and mentor a team of engineers, ensuring best practices in software development, high level system design, and low level implementation design
  • Design and implement scalable, resilient, and high-performance distributed systems.
  • Own technical decisions related to high level system design, infrastructure, and performance optimizations.
  • Build and optimize large-scale data pipelines and query performance for efficient data processing.
  • Work closely with product managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
  • Ensure best practices in code quality, testing, CI/CD, and deployment strategies.
  • Continuously improve system reliability, security, and scalability to handle fintech-grade workloads.
  • Own the functional reliability and uptime of 24x7 live services, ensuring minimal downtime and quick incident resolution.
  • Champion both functional and non-functional quality attributes, such as performance, availability, scalability, and maintainability.

• 7+ years of hands-on software development experience with a track record of building scalable and distributed systems.
  • Minimum 1 year of experience managing/mentoring a team
  • Should have worked on consumer-facing systems in a B2C environment.
  • Expertise in high level system design and low level implementation design, with experience handling high-scale, low-latency applications.
  • Strong coding skills in languages like Java, Go, Python, or Kotlin.
  • Experience with databases and query optimizations, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, or NoSQL (DynamoDB, Cassandra etc.).
  • Deep understanding of data pipelines, event-driven systems, and distributed messaging systems like Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.
  • Proficiency in cloud platforms like AWS and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Kubernetes).
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills with a passion for performance optimization.

• Prior experience in fintech, payments, lending, or banking domains.
  • Exposure to real-time analytics and big data technologies (Spark, Flink, Presto, Clickhouse, etc.).
  • Experience with containerization and microservices architecture.
  • Open-source contributions or active participation in tech communities.

• Be part of an early-stage fintech startup solving real-world financial challenges.
  • Work on cutting-edge technology that handles millions of transactions daily.
  • Opportunity to lead and grow in a high-impact leadership role.
  • Collaborate with a world-class team of engineers, product leaders, and fintech experts.
  • In-person role in Bengaluru – an exciting, fast-paced work environment!
  • Collaborating directly with Sambhav (Co-founder) and Chirag (Founding Team – Head, Engineering) to lead the engineering team, develop scalable solutions, and ensure seamless delivery of key projects.
